title: Mixed Event — A Bright Future!! — Episode2 Special News

meta.Event Outline: Bit by bit, the members of Leo/need continue preparations for their first show together. Their new song is coming along well, and all that's left is for Ichika to add her lyrics. She's determined to express the feelings that Saki put into the composition, but will it be so easy...?

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was hoping to finish writing my lyrics by today's practice, but that didn't really go as planned...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Our show's coming up too.
If I don't get my act together, we won't have enough time to practice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I just don't understand.
No matter how many times I try, I can't seem to find the right words for this...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (When I first heard Saki's song, I thought I knew what I wanted to write...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But how do I put those thoughts into words...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi!
Wanna head to practice?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, uh... Sure!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
You seem good, Shihoppy♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You want to see how I react, don't you, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I have no idea what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, would you mind helping us with practice again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course.
Are you practicing for your next show?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, there's that and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We still need to practice our song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, the one you finished the other day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
I've been so excited about finally getting to play it as a band!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me too.
I'm sure you all pretty much know it by heart now, but we still need to polish it up for our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did you bring your lyrics, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, about that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry, they're still not done yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you rush like this. You still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I'm the one holding you all up.
I'll keep doing what I can to actually finish them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we get started with practice? We can start with Miku's songs that are gonna be in our show...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, wait!
Can you hang on just one second?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, I have some special news that's gonna knock your socks off!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Special news?! Tell us! Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, here it goes...!
We have a really cool new addition to our group!
I can take it from here, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: KAITO...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what you mean by special news at first but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so amazing!
It's KAITO! Like, the real deal!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, this is pretty big news.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You didn't have to go that far, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, you wouldn't have come out of your hidey hole if I didn't!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You sounded so eager to meet them yesterday too! But lo and behold, you were too scared to actually meet them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And the worst part is how you tried to slyly walk in after the girls had left! Isn't it fair to say you were gonna do the same thing today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm with Rin on this one. To be honest, I would've forced you out of hiding if she didn't do what she just did.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. This is all on you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... If now isn't a good time, we can wait until later to properly introduce ourselves to each other...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, it's nothing like that.
He's just shy is all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shy...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, very.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, he's also very good at what he does. It's as if he can converse through music.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
He really knows how to create a great atmosphere during performances!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He's taught me so much already!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, would like to stay and watch us practice?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Please!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we all greet each other by playing something together?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, right now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! I'm totally for that!
I really wanna hear what KAITO's like when he plays!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If he really can converse through music, I'd like to hear that as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me as well...!
That is, if you're both okay with that, Miku, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you think, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting anything like this...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(So powerful...!
It's like I'm being pulled into the song...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's not like he's just showing off either. He's playing so that his sound compliments everybody else's, but he still has this incredible presence...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It almost feels like the music is somehow alive... As if he's trying to tell us something.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This sound...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is this what they meant by conversing through music...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You really are something else, KAITO.
Can you tell us what was going through your mind while you were playing that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wanted you all to see a new door opening in front of you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A new door...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean you were trying to cheer us on?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it certainly did have that feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. The way he played went so well with how everyone else was playing too. I'd love to learn how to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much for that, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to finish writing those lyrics if we're going to fully open that door KAITO just showed us...)
